subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Alaska in the USA / is the colder / of all the states.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect comparative form "**colder**" being used instead of the superlative form "**coldest**."
 
• When comparing more than two entities, the superlative form of an adjective should be used.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**is the coldest** of all the states," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Alaska in the USA is the coldest of all the states."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 4: "Alaska in the USA"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 2: "is the colder"** – This part contains the error as explained above.
 
• **Part 3: "of all the states."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
